title: Methods mentioned in books but not implemented here

explanation.default: Reference books list many sutras (for example Anurupyena or Paravartya). This application currently implements only nikhilam, urdhva, ekadhikena, yavadunam, and ekanyunena. Do not invent animations or practice for other methods.
explanation.beginner: That method may exist in books, but this app cannot open it yet. Try Urdhva or Nikhilam instead.

source_references.title: Fundamentals & Applications of Vedic Mathematics (2014)
source_references.printed_page_note: PDF page index 8 (0-based); printed page may differ

history_vs_math_note: Mathematical claims here are independently checkable algebra/place-value. Traditional origin claims about the Vedas are not asserted as established fact.
